title: Collection of cells for single-cell RNA sequencing using high-resolution fluorescence microscopy
protocol: Filter serum-free medium using a 0.2 μm filter.
Trypsinize cells according to routine procedures.
Spin down cells to collect cells in a pellet (3 min, 400 rcf for hTERT RPE-1 cells).
Remove medium and reconstitute cell pellet in filtered serum-free medium.
Optional: if serum was used to inactivate the trypsin, spin down the cells again and reconstitute them in fresh serum-free medium.
Count the cells with an automated cell counter such as the Bio-Rad TC20.
Dilute approximately 7500 cells in 200 μL of filtered serum-free medium.
If not all cells harbor a fluorescent marker, add Hoechst33342 (1:20,000 dilution) to the cell suspension.
Reconstitute the cell pellet in serum-free medium.
Apply negative pressure of −20 mbar on chips with 5 μm pores, or −100 mbar on chips with 2 μm pores.
Stop the pump immediately when the chip runs almost dry (a <1 mm thick film of liquid remains).
Clean the bottom of the chip by pipetting 4–5 times with 1 ml sterile filtered PBS on the backside of the chip.
Remove the last droplets of PBS from the corner of the chip using absorbent paper.
Mount the chip on the Puncher and immediately pipette 150–200 μl of serum-free medium onto the chip to keep cells in a wet environment.
Clean the backside of the chip, ensuring it is completely dry and free from salt crystals or large dust particles.
Align the chip according to the instructions provided by the puncher software.
Focus the chip using one of the fluorescence filters or the reflection channel.
Scan relevant fluorescent channels as well as the reflection channel.
Select cells of interest via automated selection by setting intensity ranges in up to 3 channels simultaneously.
Load a file with predefined cup numbers to select cells of interest.
Manually select cells if automated selection is not preferred.
Scroll through the list of selected cells to visually inspect their quality.
Remove doublets or dead cells from the list.
Punch cells into microwell plate.
Take a ready-to-use 384-well plate containing CEL-Seq2 primers from the −20°C freezer.
Briefly spin down the plate at 1 min and 2000 rfc.
Remove the foil and place the plate on the puncher.
Assign each selected cell to a specific well ID of the 384-well plate using VYCAP software.
Punch the cells into the designated wells.
Immediately seal the plate with adhesive foil after the last punch.
Spin down the plate at 1 min and 2000 rfc.
Transfer the sealed plate immediately to a −80°C freezer for storage until library preparation.
Spin down and freeze the plate immediately after the last punch.
Optionally, assign and punch a limited number of cells (5–10) initially.
Check the after-images to ensure successful punching.
Troubleshoot by quickly replacing or recalibrating the needle if necessary.
